description:
Report wrong, outdated, or missing details on an app that IS in the appclap catalog — e.g. the user says the price changed, a feature is gone, the category is wrong, or the app has shut down.

The report is a signal, not an edit: appclap re-verifies the record against the app's own website, which remains the only source of truth — so a report never directly changes data, it triggers re-checking. reason must be one of: pricing_wrong, feature_wrong, category_wrong, app_dead, other. For apps NOT in the catalog, use submit_app instead.

details.description: What exactly is wrong or missing, per the user.

name: report_app_issue
